q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This range sets the ceiling near $92.8 billion and the floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is approximately $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) or $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), which falls within NVIDIA's guidance range.

NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, exceeding its own guidance. The Q2 FY2027 outlook assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), a stance in its second year [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The company's CFO, Colette Kress, anticipates $20 billion in total CPU revenue for the full fiscal year [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).
